team_notes.BAL: Jacoby Brissett starts while Lamar (thumb, IR) and Huntley (toe) are out (Hensley via RotoBaller Nov 8; WagerTalk Nov 16). Feed still lists Huntley until Brissett's first game is played.
team_notes.SEA: Darnold (quad/ribs) won't play Wk10 (Macdonald, Nov 9); Lock (elbow/oblique) expected to start, Milroe backup. Darnold targets Nov 29 after the bye.
team_notes.CLE: Browns plan to start Watson vs HOU (ESPN source, Nov 9); Monken not confirmed. Sanders 297 yds in Wk9.
team_notes.MIN: Murray Grade 2 hamstring, questionable at best (SI, Nov 10); Wentz benched late Wk9 for Brosmer; trade deadline Tue.
team_notes.KC: Kenneth Walker III (groin) expected to play Wk11, 'minor ... precautionary' (Rapoport via CBS/RotoWire Nov 15); resumes lead role over rookie Emmett Johnson. Kelce (ankle) limped off Wk10 but returned (SIC Nov 15).
team_notes.LAC: Herbert avoided a finger fracture (NFL.com, Nov 9); McConkey scratched Wk9 (back).
team_notes.GB: Josh Jacobs fractured a finger (right hand) in Wk9 (Nov 8).
team_notes.NE: Stevenson (knee) imaging; A.J. Brown expected to travel to Germany, no decision; RG Ben Brown not traveling (Vrabel, Nov 9).
team_notes.DEN: Jonah Coleman the clear lead back after 58 of 75 snaps in Wk9 (Draft Sharks, Nov 9); Harvey and Badie on IR. Wk10 bye.
team_notes.CHI: Monangai out until Wk11; Luther Burden concussion (Nov 8).
team_notes.ARI: Rookie Carson Beck starts (Minshew, M. Wilson IR). Allgeier had all 17 RB carries in Wk9; Bam Knight (concussion) full practice Thu (SIC, Nov 12).
team_notes.NYJ: Geno Smith (left ankle) left Wk10 after X-rays; Glenn: availability 'determined during the week' (NYJets.com/ESPN Nov 15). Rookie Cade Klubnik starts if Smith can't. Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) left Wk10.
team_notes.NYG: Skattebo had all 18 RB carries in the Wk10 TNF game (box score, Nov 12).
team_notes.HOU: Woody Marks (concussion, Wk10) unlikely for TNF (Ryans, RotoWire Nov 15); Montgomery (groin) ramping up, Ryans 'not certain' (ESPN/RotoWire Nov 15). Demercado/Ogunbowale behind. Backfield left to the official report.
team_notes.LV: Brock Bowers (ankle) left Wk10, re-evaluated Monday (Kubiak via PFT Nov 15). Mendoza starts.
